scene: Korean web animation 「조선으로 회귀하면」 episode 1. A delivery rider from 2026 is stuck in 1795 Hanyang (Joseon-era Seoul) on the night of the curfew bell.

민재.profile: Minjae: 27-year-old Korean male delivery rider. Playful, flustered, talks casually like to a friend, Seoul accent.

댕이.profile: Daengi: a small guide spirit born from a bell's chime, acting as a game guide. Refined, poised and witty: a smooth, elegant, confident voice like a sophisticated premium AI concierge. Playful only in subtle, understated ways; never childish or squeaky.

목소리.profile: A hidden system voice (Daengi before appearing): crisp, elegant game announcement, slightly mysterious and composed.

돌쇠.profile: Dolsoe: a 10-year-old boy errand runner at an inn. Smart, sassy, talks fast.

순라군.profile: A Joseon-era night patrol soldier. Deep, intimidating, old-fashioned historical-drama speech.

윤진사.profile: Scholar Yoon: a calm, dignified scholar in his 30s from the Joseon era. Historical-drama speech, quietly kind.

주모.profile: Jumo: the innkeeper woman in her 40s. Hearty, quick-witted, brisk merchant tone.
